need: Deterministic radiating-ray emblem (hub + N angular rays/sectors of a chosen block, optional alternating sectors) placed on a wall plane with a given radius and facing.
evidence: Sunburst/fan emblem: no brush; angular sectors computed in script and gold blocks placed by hand (closest arch/disc, no ray pattern).

need: When text does not fit band width at the chosen font, emit a result note and automatically drop margin/frame before falling back to 2-row letters, instead of silently switching.
evidence: plaque fell back to 2-row banner letters when band narrower than text+margins (4-letter name needs 19 cols); needed widening and frame:null; a fit-to-width note would have saved two renders.

tool: plaque (relief raised) + mcd check orphan detection
need: Raised lettering strokes must be recognised as attached (not ORPHAN) by mcd check, or plaque should report which blocks are intentionally unsupported by a wall.
evidence: Stroke ends of raised letters reported as ORPHAN by mcd check (2 blocks); relief:raised and checker disagree; relief:flush was the workaround.

need: Classify full-block light sources such as sea_lantern as solid blocks, not hanging lanterns, so the support check does not flag them.
evidence: mcd check treats sea_lantern as hanging lantern (UNSUPPORTED, nothing below to hang from), 8 false positives; it is a full block.

need: Deterministic marquee: a projecting canopy at a given door height on a facade with a fascia band, under-light row and optional hanging lanterns, supported on a wall of another storey.
evidence: Marquee/canopy: no brush; black box plus sea lanterns, banner-letter fascia and hanging lanterns placed by hand; roof --preset cafe cantilever cannot sit at door height.

need: Small freestanding or recessed booth brush (counter, window opening, roof, door) placed against a facade or within a plaza footprint.
evidence: Ticket booth/kiosk hand-placed; surround/glazing only work on openings.

need: Repeating zigzag or chevron band along a wall top or course line, built from alternating stair facings with a set period and depth.
evidence: Chevron/zigzag frieze: no brush; stair facings alternated by hand; cornice and courses are straight only.

need: Roof tool accepts a keep/skip region for a planned tower, and setbacks clears the deck/parapet/rail beneath each tier, plus per-tier window/slit placement.
evidence: Stepped tower: setbacks give hollow shell with solid top; parapet/rail the roof tool placed under it had to be cleared by hand; tier windows by hand.

need: Flat preset with a single-material deck by default (or a material mix option) so ROOF_SINGLE_MATERIAL does not fire and no custom spec is needed.
evidence: modern flags ROOF_SINGLE_MATERIAL with a two-tone default deck; needed --spec with custom material.mix; --texture slate did not change tone count for flat-parapet.

need: A parapet material option independent of the top wall course colour on flat-roof presets.
evidence: modern takes parapet colour from top wall course; black frieze gave black parapet on dark deck; had to make top course cream; no parapet material option.

need: Recess a rectangular panel into a wall face by carving an outer layer and setting an inner layer back by a set depth, with an optional frame.
evidence: Side-wall recessed panels: no brush; carved outer layer and backed inner layer by hand in a loop; paint louvres works only on glass.

tool: fixtures at doors / exit door with sign
need: Door fixture option that places an exit sign (sign block) above a door with the correct facing, not only lamps.
evidence: Exit doors with EXIT sign above hand-placed with B.door and B.sign; fixtures at doors only adds lamps.

need: Code brush for a tower finial stack (base block, lightning rod, end rod) on a given top centre, mirroring the mcd paint finial rule.
evidence: Finial stack of gold block, lightning_rod, end_rod placed by hand; finial rule exists only in mcd paint, not as a code brush.

tool: signboard hanging / render of hanging blade signs
need: Render or option for slim vertical hanging signs (neon-style) instead of chunky boxes with chains.
evidence: Hanging blade signs (signboard hanging) render as chunky boxes with chains; no slim vertical sign option.
